title: Low Pressure Lockout
shortDescription: Heat pump low side pressure too low.
fullDescription: LP indicates AquaCal heat pump shut down due to low refrigerant pressure, often from cold ambient air, restricted airflow, or refrigerant leak.

title: High Pressure Lockout
fullDescription: HP indicates the heat pump shut down on high refrigerant pressure. Causes include low water flow, hot ambient, or fan failure.

title: No Water Flow
fullDescription: FS indicates the water flow switch did not detect adequate flow.

fixSteps.title: Open valves
fixSteps.instruction: Ensure valves to heater are open.

title: Water Sensor Open or Short
fullDescription: WS indicates water temperature sensor reads invalid value.

title: Ambient Air Sensor Fault
fullDescription: AS indicates ambient air sensor open or shorted.

title: Defrost Mode Active
fullDescription: DE is informational - heat pump reversing valve has activated defrost. Normal in cool weather.

title: Coil Sensor Fault
fullDescription: CS indicates the coil temperature sensor has failed, affecting defrost logic.

title: Power Failure Detected
fullDescription: PF indicates a power outage was detected. Heat pump waits 5 minutes then resumes.

title: Freeze Protection Lockout
shortDescription: Heat pump locked out for freeze.
fullDescription: FL indicates the heat pump is locked out below 40F to protect the heat exchanger.

title: Control Communication Error
fullDescription: CE indicates communication failure between display and control board. Reseat ribbon cable.
